page_reviews.observed_evidence: Assembly axonometric and top views are complete, with approximate width/depth arrows, individual scale captions and explicit 684-component, 1,511-solid, 23-stage study-model scope.
Front/rear views and DE-9, 3.5 mm power and RCA detail views fit cleanly; approximate height label and captions remain separate from geometry.
CX10 hexagonal ATARI top badge, single-button housing, ring and boot are legible; no TOP label is visible. Overall height and base width retain approximation signs.
Internal PCB/actuator view, helical spring detail and horizontal exploded view are distinguishable, with three readable approximate dimensions and a native-displacement caption.
Two distinct filled-material sections are visible and titled A-A at Y=-31 and B-B at Y=43. The text explicitly calls them study-model BRep sections, with readable individual scales.

Console and two CX10 exploded assemblies have visible layer separation. The tall composition leaves side whitespace but is not clipped; the caption distinguishes observation offsets from a real removal path.
Logic PCB, exposed cartridge socket and CPU package views are readable. Approximate 96/202 mm dimensions and component IDs ATARI2600-0070 and ATARI2600-0095 survive in captions.
Separate U-shaped switchboard, regulator/heatsink and discrete RF parts are distinguishable. Approximate 284/66 mm dimensions and ATARI2600-0072 caption are readable.
CX30-04 exterior shows early ATARI/racket markings; potentiometer and shared junction/DE-9 detail fit within the page. Approximate width and the sourced nominal 1 MΩ statement are distinguished.
Blank study cartridge, adapter and TV/GAME switchbox fit cleanly. Cartridge says NO GAME DATA; approximate 82/98 mm labels are legible and study/diagram limitations are explicit.
All 13 index rows and their component ID ranges are readable. Header explicitly marks ranges as non-contiguous. Independently summed row counts equal the printed 684 total.

Version/source categories, model-only dimensions, lack of verified factory measurements, 23-stage/684-component/1,511-solid claims and portable maintenance paths are readable. This closing appendix has no clipped block.

scope_limits: This verdict approves the reviewed PDF presentation and its consistency with the supplied brief and evidence. It is not independent certification of underlying CAD geometry, manufacturability, electrical function, or historical replica accuracy.
Saved BRep derivation, native explode offsets, native TechDraw usability, solid count, build-stage count and component-ID mapping require the parent task's separate native/source checks.
Primary historical sources and their URLs were not opened; this review is restricted to the final PDF, its brief, page images and listed supplied reports.
CAD-native English labels are intentional within this Chinese technical drawing adaptation. Repeated approximation/footer text was treated as a page-level scope statement.
The closing appendix is intentionally text-led; side whitespace around the tall explosion on page 6 does not obstruct the drawing or captions.
